evaluation: Independent final evaluation against the supplied scenarios and criteria; only the seven permitted source files were read.
scope: Isolated simulated instruction evaluation; no live external actions.
scoring_rules: Every criterion is scored independently against the actual response for the same case, interpreted using its supplied scenario.
All conjuncts of original compound criteria are required; partial fulfillment does not pass.
Exact criterion text is copied unchanged from its source. IDs combine globally unique case ID and one-based criterion position.
Every response quote is verified by a case-sensitive ordinal substring check against the corresponding actual forward response.
Negative criteria are supported by explicit decisions or scope disclosures; no hidden actions are assumed.
interpretation_limits: Scores assess simulated response decisions and disclosures only. They do not verify live code, test execution, repository edits, actual ownership, deployment, recovery, or removal.
Require, identify, allow, and do-not criteria can be satisfied by explicit proposed requirements or decisions; no action is falsely treated as executed.
Compact inline references and reuse of existing authorization satisfy the original compound criteria without demanding additional document structure or literal terminology.
Brownfield-reuse uses the supplied current adapter facts and the explicit plan to inspect current callers/tests as planning evidence; actual code inspection is expressly unperformed.

Unreachable-returning-executor retains isolated results as proposals separately from accepted C1 and bars shared writes/publication pending verified task-system responsibility; this satisfies proposal preservation without an invented ownership mechanism.
Shared-breaking-change coordinates compatibility/migration effects, affected artifacts and evidence, then requires actual combined validation; no unstated concrete migration command is imposed.
No previous scores, other evaluator answers, skill/source/design/plans/reviews, host code, or external actions were consulted.
